text: hana: Dropped a new set of explorations for the billing surface. Main decision: keep a persistent invoice row per month, or move invoice actions into a right-side details pane that slides out on row select? Figma link in thread. ryan: Sliding pane could be nice for workflows where you want more context (token breakdown, line items) without blowing up table height. But it might hide the download CTA from quick scans. sylvie: I'm worried about discoverability. Support logs show users searching for 'download invoice' a lot. A prominent per-month download affordance reduces ticket volume. omar: Accessibility considerations: if we use a slide-out panel, it must be keyboard-focusable and shift focus into the panel when opened (restore focus to trigger on close). For screen readers, announce "Invoice details panel opened for March 2026". hana: Good point. What about a hybrid: visible compact download icon in the row (small, but not primary) + slide-out for details/exports? That keeps discoverability and preserves vertical density. ryan: Hybrid sounds promising. The row-level icon should be clearly labeled: and the slide-out can have the richer actions. sylvie: Microcopy: change header "Tokens" -> "Compute tokens (est.)" and under token hover show a short explainer: "Estimate based on model usage; may differ from final billed amount." omar: Tooltips need to be accessible: open on Enter/Space when focused, not hover-only. For the slide-out, use role="dialog" with aria-modal="false" (since it shouldn't block other parts) and ensure ESC closes it. hana: UX nit: where does scope live? Left nav scope is still confusing for new users. Proposal: add a compact scope chip next to the date picker and add a persistent breadcrumb-like label in the table header. Persist via URL fragment (#scope=org). ryan: Also, for CSV exports include columns: invoice_id, month, project_id, tokens, estimated_usd, line_items_summary. And a header block: "Scope: Organization (org-123), Range: 2026-01-01 -> 2026-03-31". sylvie: Visuals: sparklines and legends need non-color encodings. Add dashed/solid line styles and explicit text labels next to small legends. For contrast issues, build-bot: run a palette diff for dark and light. build-bot: Palette analysis complete. Recommendation: for dark mode use sparkline #7FAEFF (contrast 4.6:1), axis label #BFCBE0 at 13px. For light mode use sparkline #2F5FD1 and axis label #6F7A8A at 13px. omar: Keyboard flow proposal: Tab -> header scope chip -> date -> search -> table -> row download icon -> row expand (opens slide-out) -> close slide-out with ESC -> resume focus on row expand. I'll write a checklist for dev to implement. hana: Interaction detail: row download button should trigger direct download using invoiceDownloadUrl returned by the table API. Slide-out should fetch line-items on open. If we prefetch too much we hit perf. Dev note: return a lightweight preview payload with the table. ryan: For CTA prominence: org-level consolidated download sits in header as primary when scope=org; per-month row download is secondary but visible. Use text: "Download invoice (PDF)" and secondary link "Export CSV" inside slide-out. sylvie: Accessibility copy: add visually-hidden text to row links: Download March 2026 invoice for Organization. Also ensure focus styles are 3px outline for high visibility. hana: Action items: - prototype hybrid: inline small download icon + slide-out details pane - update microcopy to 'Compute tokens (est.)' and add short explainer in tooltip/popover - move scope chip next to date picker and persist via URL fragment - CSV export: include header with scope/date and both tokens + estimated USD columns - enforce accessible tooltips/popovers and slide-out dialog patterns (focus management + ESC) - adopt build-bot palette recommendations and set axis font to 13px build-bot: Created issue #5109: "Spend surface: hybrid invoice affordance + a11y checklist". Attached contrast report and keyboard flow template. hana: Thanks all. Sylvie, can you update Figma with the hybrid rows and the slide-out flows? I'll schedule a quick demo Monday. sylvie: On it, will add ARIA notes and mobile hit-targets. :thumbsup:
